snippet.title: Bug Heroes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available on the app store!
http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bug-heroes/id412789616?mt=8

Part endless survival, part castle defense, and part RPG, Bug Heroes is a brand new gaming experience by the developers who brought you N.Y.Zombies. 

In Bug Heroes players will switch between 3 heroes -- at any time on the battlefield -- each with their own skills, equipment, strengths and weaknesses. Scour the lands for food, upgrade your food stash with turrets, accept optional side quests, and most importantly survive as long as possible. 

- 3 unique heroes -- switch between them anywhere, anytime
- RPG elements: 30+ abilities and equipment, level ups, passive skills, side quests, interesting story and personalities
- Castle defense elements: build turrets and defend your food stash!
- Over 25 enemy types
- 2 game modes for both hardcore and casual gamers
- And so much more...
